description: Scenarios where an updated event's doc is not the document MongoDB stored, each a defect a later change fixes. Each entry has `scenario` (a scenario id; `*` matches one path segment), optional `mongoose` (a major version) and `reason`. An entry that matches no violation fails the run: remove it with the fix.
